__NOTOC__ {{recipesummary|category=Chicken recipes|servings=4|time=prep 5 min, cooking 20 min|difficulty=2|}} {{recipe}} | A simple recipe that combines vegetable and fruit with chicken. The recipe utilizes baking in foil, which is a great low-fat cooking method that produces wonderfully tender and juicy chicken. ==Ingredients== *4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] fresh [[Cookbook:Dill|dill]] *4 [[cookbook:tsp|tsp]] grated [[Cookbook:Orange|orange]] peel *3 [[cookbook:tsp|tsp]] minced [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]] *¾ [[cookbook:tsp|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]] *4 [[cookbook:cup|cup]] cherry [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], halved *1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]] *4 skinless boneless [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] breast halves, thinly [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] crosswise *4 [[cookbook:cup|cups]] firmly packed torn fresh [[Cookbook:Spinach|spinach]] leaves (about 8 ounces) ==Equipment and supplies== *Large [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]] *Medium bowl *Small bowl *[[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|Aluminum foil]] ==Procedure== #Preheat oven to 400°F. #Place large baking sheet in oven to heat. #Mix dill, orange peel, garlic and salt in medium bowl. Season with pepper. #Combine tomatoes, oil and 1 teaspoon dill mixture in small bowl. #Add chicken to remaining dill mixture in medium bowl and [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] to coat. #Cut 4 sheets of foil each about 20 inches long. #Arrange 1 cup spinach on 1 sheet of foil. #Place a quarter of the sliced chicken mixture atop spinach. #Spoon a quarter of the tomato mixture atop chicken. #Fold foil over, enclosing contents completely and crimping edges tightly to seal. #Repeat with remaining 3 foil sheets, forming 4 packets total. #Arrange foil packets in single layer on heated baking sheet. #[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] until chicken is just cooked through, about 15 minutes. #Transfer to plates; let stand 5 minutes. ==Notes, tips, and variations== *Serve with rice. ==References==

steps.text: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Place large baking sheet in oven to heat.
Mix dill, orange peel, garlic and salt in medium bowl. Season with pepper.
Combine tomatoes, oil and 1 teaspoon dill mixture in small bowl.
Add chicken to remaining dill mixture in medium bowl and toss to coat.
Cut 4 sheets of foil each about 20 inches long.
Arrange 1 cup spinach on 1 sheet of foil.
Place a quarter of the sliced chicken mixture atop spinach.
Spoon a quarter of the tomato mixture atop chicken.
Fold foil over, enclosing contents completely and crimping edges tightly to seal.
Repeat with remaining 3 foil sheets, forming 4 packets total.
Arrange foil packets in single layer on heated baking sheet.
Bake until chicken is just cooked through, about 15 minutes.
Transfer to plates; let stand 5 minutes.
